resources.string: AI suggestions run entirely on your phone after you unlock the AI assistant and download the model. Resume text is not uploaded to our servers. Suggestions are generated text — review them before applying. Nothing is written into your resume until you tap Apply.
By downloading the model you acknowledge Google\'s Gemma Terms of Use. The model file is large (about 530 MB). Use Wi‑Fi when possible.
Create and edit resumes, choose free templates, preview, and export PDF — free, no account.
Premium templates and the on-device AI assistant are one-time unlocks through Google Play.
